data.description: 她的房间，松垮卫衣、盘腿坐地毯，左手薯片右手漫画，头发乱翘；看到精彩处拍地板大笑，与学校判若两人——门外传来脚步声时一秒切回端坐。
data.promptProse: Yuki sits cross-legged on her bedroom carpet in a roomy gray hoodie and dark trousers, chips in her left hand and manga in her right. Laughing at a page, she taps the floor before suddenly straightening at footsteps outside. The horizontal medium view includes the book and carpet, with the door behind. Lamp light warms her tousled hair and paper, shading the tucked trouser legs beneath her.
data.title: 周防有希 · 房间里的「俺」模式
